title:
During provisioning, we transpile JavaScript sources file written in defined versions of ECMAScript down when needed
for the declared package runtimes. The target version is always the lowest-common denominator (ES5). If the type is
not annotated with a specific JS version, ES5 is assumed and no transpilation is performed.

For any type which requires transpilation (has a JavaScript implementation and declares a higher ECMAScript version
than ES5), a metadata file will be produced for the transpiled source and the source map. For "foo.js", "foo.js5"
and "foo.js_map" will be produced. The transpiled file will appear in the type's source map for the language
"JavaScript5".

Transpilation is actually performed using {@link https://babeljs.io/ Babel}, to provide consistency with delivery
through the web application.
name: JavaScriptTranspiler
